description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Twin Element Mode II (Fire, Earth)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Successor Mode I (Krile)] and [Fire/Earth Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Twin Element Mode II (Fire, Earth)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Earth with Stacking] after using a Fire/Earth ability

description.name: Dual Awoken Successor Mode I (Krile)
description.text: Fire and Earth abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire and Earth abilities trigger 2 additional times, casts Dual Consuming Flame after using two equipped Fire or Earth abilities

description.name: Fire/Earth Resonance +5% Boost
description.text: Fire and Earth abilities deal 5% more damage

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Successor Mode II (Krile)], removes [Dual Awoken Successor Mode I (Krile)]
